follows.note: XM-fast: its windows, cuts, clusters, leads, conditions, rule, P extraction and scorer, unchanged

build.note: the modules commit (modules main) and each module's wasm SHA-256; every wasm is read with git show at that commit, never from a working tree

xm.code: XM's lib/truth.mjs, lib/weather.mjs, lib/public.mjs, lib/sds.mjs and lib/modules.mjs are imported unchanged; experiments/xp-atmosphere-merit must equal the commit (git diff --quiet) for every run
xm.rows: XM's stored rows (<xm store>/rows/*.jsonl), read only: every rerun P and X2 must equal them
xm.dcl: XM's cached $DCL answers (<xm store>/dcl/<issue ms>.json), read only; a missing one is an error, never computed here

period.cutoff: 00:00 UTC of every day of the period
period.why: XM's period: C2 holds out every calibration object from cutoff 2026-06-01 on (integrity cut 2)

F2.label: propagator/ffm fitted by analysis/estimation fit_batch version 3 to the 72 h precise arc, NRLMSISE-00 on the condition's $SPW rows

F3.label: F2 times the open-DCA $DCL: the same fit and forecast with the density multiplied by exp(s(t))

X2.label: XM's X2 (SGP4XP, NRLMSISE-00 on the same rows), rerun with XM's code and required equal to XM's stored row

P.label: XM's P (the public Space-Track set under the console's SGP4), rerun with XM's code and required equal to XM's stored row

fit.module: analysis/estimation fit_batch version 3 answered by propagator/ffm invoke, driven by harness/ffm-fit-v3.mjs fitV3 (one round at the stated sigma; domains from propagator/ffm's FIT_PARAMETER_DOMAINS; ok only when CONVERGED)
fit.profile: P0: C2 classes R1 and R2 (experiments/ffm-covariance-calibration run.mjs settingsOf(o, true)), B2 A12's selected profile
estimated: the GCRF position and velocity at the arc's first state
DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS (B = Cd A/m, m2/kg, domain [0, inf))
SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS (AGOM = Cr A/m, m2/kg, domain [0, inf))

seeds.rule: the object's bSeed and agomSeed (published area and mass: B = A/m x 2.2, AGOM = A/m x 1.3); they are the parameters' first values and a priori means

apriori.form: diagonal (6 + 2)^2: position 100 km, velocity 10 m/s, each parameter 30 % of its seed

fit.forcesNote: EGM2008 70 x 70 in Earth-fixed axes, the Sun and the Moon from DE440s, cannonball radiation pressure with the conical shadow, NRLMSISE-00 drag, IERS 2010 solid tides and relativity; no ocean tides, Earth radiation or winds (B2 part1.starlink.ffm.forces, C2's)
fit.integratorNote: RK78 (harness/ffm-execution.mjs): relative tolerance 1e-10, absolute 1e-7 (m, m/s), initial step 60 s, minimum 1e-4 s, maximum 120 s, at most 1,000,000 steps; analytic STM, the density gradient by finite difference
fit.arc: XM's 72 h arc: the truth's states in [cutoff - 72 h, cutoff], every round(300 / step)-th state of the product's own grid (XM lib/truth.mjs thinned); the reference epoch is the arc's first state
fit.coverage: XM's rule: an arc holding less than 90 % of its states is not fitted and the window leaves the F and X2 cells, counted
fit.loss: a fit that does not end CONVERGED (MAXIMUM_ITERATIONS, STALLED, a fit-failed request), a refused forecast or a non-finite state fails its F arm in every bin of the window (rule 3), never dropped

forecast: propagator/ffm invoke from the fitted state and parameters (harness/ffm-fit-v3.mjs propagateV3, the fit's forces, integrator and inputs, no STM) to the scored epochs, GCRF, meters to kilometers

earthOrientation.rows: its earth_orientation_finals rows (IERS finals.all.iau2000.txt retrieved 2026-10-09, parsed by data-source/eop-parser; B1 amendments A1 and A2); B1's rule takes them for every arc before 2026-07-15 (its saved rows begin at MJD 61236), as C2's fits of these objects took them
earthOrientation.slice: B1's forArc: the rows with MJD in [MJD(arc start - 2 d) - 1, MJD(last scored epoch + 2 d) + 1], one PRW EARTH_ORIENTATION
earthOrientation.disclosure: final values over the forecast horizon, not the predictions issued at the cutoff; the effect at 7 days is meters against errors of kilometers; P and the X arms use no Earth orientation

spaceWeather.rows: XM's rows of the condition (XM lib/weather.mjs rowsO and rowsM, from cutoff - 72 h - 3 d), the same rows X2 reads, as SDS SPW rows (DATE, F107_OBS, F107_OBS_CENTER81, AP_AVG) in one PRW SPACE_WEATHER table
spaceWeather.holdLast: condition O: rowsO ends on D0 + 2 (the RSGA's last predicted day); its last row is repeated, every value, on each later day through D0 + 8, exactly the values sdn-ap's HOLD_LAST holds for X2 (propagator/ffm reads only the rows it is given and needs every day of the arc and the day before: prw_dynamics.cpp:1188-1191); data preparation only
spaceWeather.rowsM: condition M: rowsM through the last scored epoch + 1 d, as XM
spaceWeather.reading: propagator/ffm (prw_environment.h:106-152) and propagator/sdn-ap read the rows alike: on UTC day d, F10.7 of day d - 1, F10.7a and Ap of day d; Kp is read only by the HWM14 winds, which are off

environment.densityCorrection: F3 only: XM's $DCL of the condition (O: the open-DCA nowcast issued at the cutoff; M: the hindcast issued at cutoff + 174 h), the bytes XM's X3 read, from XM's cache; a window whose $DCL was refused fails F3 (a loss), as X3

O.excluded: a cutoff with no RSGA in force (2026-01-01) leaves O, counted

M.run: a sensitivity: run only after every O window is stored and only if time remains; its absence changes no verdict

notRun.GN: XM's GNSS control tested SGP4XP's atmosphere switch above the drag-free altitude; it does not bear on this question
notRun.24 h arc: XM showed a 24 h arc does not determine the drag term (X2 against X0 within 0.3 % of 1)
notRun.X0, X3: not needed: the contrasts are against P and X2

outOfScope.TerraSAR-X 31698: C2 holds it out by object (cut 1)
outOfScope.Sentinel-1D 66315: C2 holds it out by object (cut 1)
outOfScope.ISS 25544: C2 holds the ISS out for 2025-01-01..2026-10-31 (cut 3)
outOfScope.laser-ranged spheres: C2's type-L hold-out and after 2026-06-01 (cuts 2 and 4)

integrity.rule: C2's held-out objects are out entirely
integrity.applied: XM's groups P and S1 only: no C2 held-out object

integrity.rule: C2's calibration objects: no cutoff on or after 2026-06-01
GPCV P0: Swarm and GRACE-FO truth read only in 2025-12-28..2026-06-08
integrity.applied: as XM; the smoke test's arc (Swarm A, cutoff 2025-12-31) lies inside it

integrity.rule: never read: C2 held-out row files, B2 part 1a and part 5 files, propagator-catalog-census results, operator-capture cycle content
integrity.applied: no step reads them; C2's seeds-R1R2.json is a calibration-time seed file from published area and mass

scoring.grid: XM's: the truth's epochs in (cutoff, cutoff + 7 d] whose offset from the first of them is a whole multiple of 300 s
scoring.bin: lead day k: (cutoff + (k - 1) d, cutoff + k d]
scoring.binRule: a bin enters when the truth holds at least 260 of its 288 grid epochs (90 %), decided by the truth alone
scoring.metric: e: the 3D RMS position error of the bin (km) in the truth's RTN axes (analysis/gp-error-model pair_statistics, XM's scorer); the along-track RMS beside it
scoring.frames: F arms are GCRF as propagator/ffm returns them; P and X2 go TEME to GCRF by foundation/frames as in XM; every arm is scored against the same GCRF truth at the same epochs
scoring.nonFinite: an arm with a non-finite state at a scored epoch fails

statistics.pairs: per group, condition, contrast and lead: the windows whose bin entered and whose reference arm was attempted
statistics.d: ln(e_arm / e_ref); arm failed: +Infinity (its loss, never dropped); else reference failed: -Infinity
statistics.p95: ln(p95 of e_arm / p95 of e_ref), a failed arm's e = +Infinity

bootstrap.unit: orbit group x ISO week of the cutoff

statistics.nan: a NaN statistic counts as +Infinity (against the arm)
statistics.converged: the CONVERGED share of the F fits, per group, condition and arm, reported beside the cells

verdict.cells: condition O, orbit-group clusters, leads 1, 2, 3 and 7, per group (P primary, S1 secondary); no pooling across groups
verdict.rule: an arm beats its reference in a group only if every lead cell meets all three: (1) the 95 % interval of the median d lies wholly below 0; (2) the upper bound of the 95 % interval of ln(p95_arm / p95_ref) is below ln 1.10; (3) the arm fails on at most 1 % of the pairs
secondary: F3 against F2 (the open DCA's own effect), condition O, the same rule
F2 against X2 and F3 against X2 (the full-force fit against XM's AP XP on the same rows), condition O, the same rule
verdict.reproduction: X2 against P from the rerun rows equals XM's registered cell

check.rule: each pinned window re-run under O and every stored number compared exactly (===); the table rebuilt from the stored rows equal to the committed table.json byte for byte

smoke.window: Swarm A 39452, cutoff 2025-12-31 (outside the period; no score): the 72 h arc fitted and forecast to cutoff + 7 d at 300 s under condition M's rows, and under the same rows with the $DCL XM cached for issue 2026-01-01T00:00Z
smoke.purpose: the cost and the encoding of PRW by the experiments' SDS 1.243.0 against propagator/ffm 2.0.4 (built on SDS 1.271.0)
